text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn) became legendary.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The rising star, Silence Suzuka! Coming off a series of spectacular graded stakes wins, can she escape all the way to the wire?!
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is underway—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Once in front, she lets no one pass!
Crossing the finish line in first place,
it's Silence Suzuka...!
(WOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

"The 'Otherworldly Fugitive' blazing past like light.
That was what they called her, but—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for being so demanding
about this race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Looking back... it almost sounded
like I was threatening them.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Still... I'm so glad I got to run...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was a truly, truly beautiful sight...
My heart is still racing just thinking about it.
Seeing her so unusually excited and talkative brought an involuntary smile to my face. Above all else, though, I was concerned about the condition of her legs.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry.
If it's just a light jog, I can still run...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I think I'll focus on
my recovery for a while...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really that surprising?
choice_data_list: To think you'd choose not to run...
To think that you would choose not to run...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, even I find it a little surprising."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...
This might take a while to explain, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In this race, coming around the third corner...
my legs just stopped moving for a split second.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I believe it started because she was already feeling run-down, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Above all, my spirit
almost broke.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The view I want to see more than anything is right before my eyes, just a little further, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If I take the next step...
it might be the end of me.
I might not be able to run anymore."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Through all of that... I heard your voice
calling out my name.
choice_data_list: I guess I might've screamed, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Hearing that voice suddenly reminded me
of the promise I made with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I promise.
I will... come back, without fail.
choice_data_list: ...All right. I'll be waiting at the finish line.
...All right. I'll be waiting at the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And so, before I knew it...
I was able to take the next step forward.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Once I took that first step, I was just so lost in the moment...
and before I knew it, I had crossed the finish line...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The scenery I saw at the finish line was truly, unbelievably beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"In that moment, I vaguely felt that together,
we could overcome whatever limits lay ahead."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe the Tenno Sho was my peak.
It's too early to decide that...!

Her face as she talked with fervent excitement
gleamed brightly under the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I want to see even more breathtaking scenery.
I want to push past my limits again and again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That...
I knew I could do it if it was with you.
choice_data_list: ...That's why I want to treat it properly.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is correct.

As she smiled like that,
she seemed, for once, just a little embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Once your leg heals, let's go see
wonderful sights together again.

And so,
the Tenno Sho became a major turning point...

Having devoted herself to treatment and completely regained her form,
the days of pushing past limits with Silence Suzuka began once more!
